today came from the afternoon Reason cycle (Claude Opus), not the overnight Spark queue.

---

## 3 Key Strategic Insights

### 1. TLT PRIORITY: Position Breakeven Analysis at 4.85% 20-Year Yield

The 20-year yield at 4.85% (DGS20, 2/19/2026) puts TLT approximately at $87-89.
Using TLT effective duration of ~17 years:

| Position | Strike | Qty  | Approx Breakeven TLT | Required Yield Drop | Probability |
|----------|--------|------|----------------------|---------------------|-------------|
| $90C     | $90    | 650  | ~$93-95 at expiry    | ~55-85bps to 4.0%   | Moderate    |
| $95C     | $95    | 300  | ~$98-100 at expiry   | ~85-105bps to 3.8%  | Low-Mod     |
| $101C    | $101   | 3150 | ~$104-107 at expiry  | ~115bps to 3.7%     | Low         |
| Shares   | -      | 1868 | At cost basis        | Any decline          | Moderate    |

Duration math: 17yr × 0.85% yield drop = ~14.5% price increase → TLT $87 × 1.145 = ~$100.
So a move from 4.85% to 4.0% gets TLT to ~$100 — making $90C and $95C profitable, but
$101C marginal. The $101C (3150 contracts) needs a recession-level catalyst.

Macro signals this week:
- Fed minutes: hawkish pause confirmed (bearish near-term for bonds)
- Jan jobs: 130k (below 150k trend — mildly supportive)
- 10-year: 4.1% (stable, not breaking lower)
- RIKB auction data captured was ICELANDIC bonds (search error) — US data still needed
- MOVE index level: NOT YET CAPTURED — critical gap

TLT VERDICT: No immediate catalyst for the ~115bps rally $101C needs. The $90C position
is more realistic. Watch: March FOMC (3/19), Q1 GDP, credit spread widening. Time decay
accelerating — 11 months to 1/15/27 expiry.

### 2. Longevity Research Hit Peak Productivity — 4 Score-5 Entries

The afternoon Reason cycle produced the best research day since tracking began:

a) p-tau217 commercial availability: 8 labs now offering testing (Labcorp test code
   484390, Mayo PT217, Lucent, Genova, TrueHealthLabs, ALZpath, C2N, Quest). Cost
   $195-$400. FDA cleared Lumipulse G pTau217/AB42 ratio May 2025. Insurance coverage
   expanding. ACTIONABLE: Matt should consider testing given 3-4 year prediction window.

b) AKL003 Phase 1b: Launched 2/19/2026 (2 days ago), actively recruiting ages 25-75.
   Alpha Klotho mRNA in LNPs, IV administration, 2:1 randomization, single site at GARM
   Clinic in Prospera, Roatan, Honduras. NOT on ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT07216781 unclear).

# Zeke Strategic Context
Last distilled: 2026-03-16

## System Architecture

**Compute:**
- DGX Spark inference server: 10.0.0.143:11434 (local cost elimination)
- 10 local models available (primary: qwen3-32b-32k, claude routing via MCP)
- Claude backend: claude-sonnet-4 (default), claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (extract)
- MCP gateway: 23 tools responding, status monitored via RPC probe

**Application Layer:**
- OpenClaw agent runtime: cron-driven + queue-driven task execution
- Cowork monitor: human-in-the-loop decision gating for high-value actions
- Cost tracker (cost-log.md): session-level spend + daily hard limits
- State consolidation: jobs.json canonical source (never split state across files)

**Memory & Knowledge:**
- Nomic-embed-text embeddings engine (local, zero cost)
- Learning-feed.jsonl: 6536 entries, daily distillation to strategic-context
- Session journal: Every diagnostic/fix logged with timestamp + outcome
- Device tagging: mac-mini, hp-mini prevent cross-machine alert false positives

**Dashboard (WIP):**
- PWA at ~/zeke-dashboard/ (service-worker.js, manifest.json)
- API endpoints: /api/spark-hardware (GPU metrics), /api/command (improvement queue)
- Next: TLT position card, touch-optimized layout for iPhone home screen

## Active Positions

**Treasury (TLT):**
- Ongoing analysis from learning feeds (7 sessions in 2026-02-17 cohort)
- Status: TLT rotation needed — recent sessions producing "No new developments" signals
- Backlog item: Evaluate yield dynamics post-rotation

**Knowledge Synthesis Queue:**
- Topics with active generation: qwen3 tool calling (15 sessions), compound memory synthesis (8), AI agent architectures (10), longevity research (5)
- All processing on local DGX (zero variable cost)
- Distillation cadence: daily at 08:45 → strategic-context update

**YouTube Member Pipeline:**
- camel-yt-pipeline-v2.py: transcription + analysis (yt-dlp at 2026.03.13)
- LaunchAgent health: LastExitStatus=0, 6h cycle
- Blocked on: Chrome login with Camel Level 3 (Matt action 3/15-3/16)
- Backfill ready: backfill-members-3-15.sh prepared

## Trading Rules

1. **Cost Control Mandatory** — Hard limits: $10/$20/$30 daily spend with automatic shutoffs. Cost monitoring before/after every change. No exceptions to oversight requirement.

2. **Model Routing Verification** — Never trust cron job model field declarations. Verify via sessions_list (observed: jobs claiming spark/glm-4.7-flash were running on claude-sonnet-4, burned $27.84/day). Local model routing for OpenClaw sessions is unreliable (tools don't work). Route claude tasks through MCP gateway only.

3. **Background Automation = Explicit Verification** — No background jobs without pre-verified health check. Learning engine operates at high velocity (47 clean sessions/night); missing oversight = blind cost bleed.

4. **Memory Search First** — Pattern discovered in compound learning: memory_search-first in agent protocols yields superior contextual decisions. Apply to decision-cr
